title: Sturgeon
disclaimer: An educational model. Not for emergency, permitting or legal use.
click_the_river: Click the water to place the release
release_half_life: Breaks down (half-life, hours; blank for no)
release_starts_back: Starts 3 days ago and plays to now, as this cycle has no forecast.
release_plays_ahead: Starts now and plays into the forecast.
mass_past_end: Past the end of the reach
legend_plain: Particles show which way the water moves and how fast.
legend_river_grey: grey where not modelled yet (the river above the Delta)
legend_rivers_fresh: the rivers above the Delta are fresh water, shown as fresh (below 0.5 psu): not measured there
legend_river_temperature: the rivers: their releases' measured temperature carried down with the weather, corrected to the measuring stations; grey where no release temperature is measured (the Yuba, Bear, Mokelumne, Cosumnes, Merced, Cache Creek)
legend_source_note: Delta: DSM2's source tracking; the river is all Sacramento water; grey in the Bay, whose model tracks no sources
flow_net_note: The particles move on the flow averaged over the tides (Godin's filter: running means over 24, 24 and 25 hours), so they show where the water is actually going over a day. A release still moves with the real tide.
x2_at: X2, where the sea's salt reaches: {km} km from the Golden Gate (DSM2's conductance at DWR's 2.64 mS/cm)
x2_seaward: X2 is west of Martinez (56 km), outside the Delta model
x2_landward: X2 is past Rio Vista (100 km)
x2_missing: X2 is not known at this time
x2_check: the past {days} days match X2 from the stations' measurements within {mean} km on average (largest {largest} km)
stations_note: Click a station for its latest readings; the model's value is shown beside where it computes the same thing.
station_no_readings: No readings in the last day
station_source: Measured: California Data Exchange Center (DWR). Model: DSM2, this run.
model_bay: NOAA's Bay forecast, corrected to the stations
legend_salinity_bay: in the Bay, NOAA's salinity corrected each day to the measuring stations (NOAA's own reads far too salty from Carquinez to Suisun Bay)
structures_note: A closed gate is drawn hollow. Click one for its latest readings.
structure_source: Measured: California Data Exchange Center (DWR, Reclamation).
gate_from_flow: read from the measured flow through the gates, as the Delta model reads it
model_note_held_open: DWR opens and closes these gates with the tide; their position is not published as live data. The Delta model holds them open, at their most common open setting.
release_kd: Sticks to sediment (partition coefficient Kd, L/kg; blank for dissolved; the Delta only)
mass_on_bed: Settled on the bed with the mud
fickian_note: The river's spreading (Fischer's dispersion) holds from about {km} km below this release; nearer, the real cloud is more drawn out and lopsided than shown (Fischer 1966)
